name: Tama-cue
source:
Players team up with Cupid Mel and try go get couples to hook up with each other -- or get the player a girlfriend in the course of it all.

(from [url=http://uk.cheats.gamespy.com/dreamcast/tama-cue/]GameSpy[/url])
translation:
玩家与丘比特梅尔组队，努力撮合情侣，或在过程中为自己找到女朋友。

（摘自[url=http://uk.cheats.gamespy.com/dreamcast/tama-cue/]GameSpy[/url]）
